claims.identified: Bulbapedia Rarity on Radiant Pokémon: "They have a special holofoil layer." A collector foil guide describes the finish as "etched, embossed silver foil covering the entire card", and a second account puts textured foil on the Pokémon figure with a geometric pattern running through the card body.
claims.separation: Radiant Pokémon (Astral Radiance onward, 2022) is not Radiant Collection (Legendary Treasures RC, Generations RC, 2013). The RC subset is `radiant`: one reconstructed concept motif per card. This paper is `radiant-etched`: etched silver across the whole card. The two share a word and nothing else, and no lookup may answer one with the other.
claims.relief: not claimed: no source measures the emboss

sheet.description: a fine etched lattice inside a wider diamond grid, over bright silver

cards.name: Radiant Venusaur
cards.evidence: Radiant Pokémon · Astral Radiance onward: Etched, embossed silver foil over the whole card, with a textured figure. Bulbapedia: Radiant Pokémon "have a special holofoil layer" and the rarity Radiant rare, introduced in Astral Radiance. A collector guide describes the finish as "etched, embossed silver foil covering the entire card"; a second account puts textured foil on the Pokémon figure with a geometric pattern running through the card body. The area is the whole face on two sources. The paper is now painted: `radiant-etched` samples a procedural etched lattice written to `public/foil/radiant-etched/sheet.png`, and `textureVerified` is false there, so the identification and the reproduction stay separate claims. NOT Radiant Collection: that is the 2013 Legendary Treasures / Generations RC subset with one motif per card (`radiant`), and the two must never share a lookup.
